news.headline: A Chinese AI company just connected its model to Wall Street's leading data providers
news.summary: Moonshot, a Chinese AI startup, just secured partnerships with major Wall Street players—including investment bank CICC and leading venture capital firms—to integrate its AI model with top-tier financial data providers. The move signals deepening AI adoption across institutional finance and gives Moonshot direct access to premium market intelligence networks.

news.headline: Salesforce issues revenue target of over $63 billion for fiscal 2030, beating estimates
news.summary: Salesforce set an ambitious long-term target: over $63B in revenue by fiscal 2030, surpassing analyst expectations. The company unveiled the projection at its flagship Dreamforce conference, signaling confidence in its growth trajectory and AI-driven strategy ahead.

educational.title: What Is Bitcoin's 'Halving' and Why Does It Matter?
points: Roughly every 4 years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half by design
This slows how fast new bitcoin enters circulation, capping supply growth
It's baked into the code — no company or person decides when it happens
Historically, halvings have preceded major price cycles, though it's not guaranteed
The last coin will ever be mined around the year 2140 due to this schedule
